name: rpm-app-project
description: Plataforma Integral de Gestión de Rankings de Pádel — Microfrontends con Native Federation

scripts.start: concurrently -n "API,APP,ADMIN,RANKINGS,TEAMS,USERS" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold,blue.bold,magenta.bold,red.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "ng serve rpm-app" "ng serve rpm-admin" "ng serve rpm-rankings" "ng serve rpm-teams" "ng serve rpm-users"
scripts.build: ng build rpm-admin && ng build rpm-rankings && ng build rpm-teams && ng build rpm-users && ng build rpm-app
scripts.build:all: ng build rpm-admin && ng build rpm-rankings && ng build rpm-teams && ng build rpm-users && ng build rpm-app
